summary: Assess tourism-site impacts, seasonal pressures and mitigation plans. Explore the five-day course outline and practical learning outcomes.
lede: Tourism project impact assessment helps teams screen sites and manage seasonal visitor pressures. For environmental specialists, tourism planners and project leads, the course covers seasonal baseline analysis, carrying-capacity assessment and impact significance with a Leopold matrix. Participants then practise developing mitigation measures, an Environmental and Social Management Plan, monitoring indicators and a decision brief.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who assess, plan or manage tourism developments and need to connect destination conditions with practical impact controls.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project planning, environmental management or impact assessment is expected. No coding or programming is required.
